about: Reel Room public demo data: a sanitized snapshot of the Halden 418 project (fictional story).

h418.name: Halden 418
h418.subtitle: Fictional small-plane emergency recreation, 20 shots (portfolio reel)

script.text: A routine evening flight for Halden Regional 418.
Twenty-eight passengers, three crew. Forty minutes from home.
Flying tonight: Captain Mara Vellan and First Officer Dev Okafor.
Fire warning, right engine!
Over Lake Tarrow, the right engine catches fire.
The crew starts the engine fire checklist.
Fuel off. Propeller feathered. Fire bottle, discharged.
Second bottle. The warning stays on.
Mayday, mayday, mayday. Halden 418, engine fire, unable to extinguish.
The nearest runway is twelve minutes away. Too far.
Captain Vellan chooses a field instead. Long, flat, and close.
The flight attendant briefs the cabin.
Gear down. Flaps out. Wings level.
Brace! Heads down, stay down!
The aircraft holds together.
All thirty-one people on board walk away.
A checklist done right, and a field chosen early.

h418__SH010.title: Ramp walk-around (S01)
h418__SH010.camera: MS, eye level 1.6 m, 50 mm. Slow TRACK RIGHT with the captain (~1.2 m/s). Start: captain screen-left, right nacelle centre. End: captain past the prop, cockpit in frame.
h418__SH010.action: Golden-hour apron, aircraft parked nose screen-right, gear down, both props stopped. Captain does the walk-around, glances at the right engine, touches a prop blade.
h418__SH010.tool_note: Gen AI, KLING 3.0 (3D-guided: Unreal blockout -> key frame -> I2V)
h418__SH010.sync: L1 0.4-4.0. FX01 ramp (idle, wind, footsteps). Music: calm drone.

script.text: A routine evening flight for Halden Regional 418.

h418__SH020.title: God's-eye overhead (S02)
h418__SH020.camera: EWS overhead, ~60 deg look-down, 50 mm, ~200 m above aircraft. Slow overhead FOLLOW, camera slower than the plane: plane drifts lower-left -> upper-right, ground slides lower-left.
h418__SH020.action: Tiny aircraft (10-12 % frame), prop discs, gear up, over autumn patchwork and Lake Tarrow. No shadow under the plane.
h418__SH020.tool_note: Gen AI, SEEDANCE 2.5 (3D-guided: Unreal blockout -> key frame -> I2V)
h418__SH020.sync: L1 tail + L2 4.4-8.0. FX02 cruise wind + drone.

script.text: Twenty-eight passengers, three crew. Forty minutes from home.

h418__SH030.title: Air-to-air cruise (S03)
h418__SH030.camera: WS air-to-air, 200 mm, level +15 m. Slow TRACK RIGHT, camera overtakes: 3/4 rear -> side-on.
h418__SH030.action: Aircraft cruising left -> right, both prop discs, gear up, low warm sun behind camera.
h418__SH030.tool_note: Gen AI, SEEDANCE 2.5 (3D-guided: Unreal blockout -> key frame -> I2V)
h418__SH030.sync: L3 starts 8.4 (crew names pre-lap the cockpit). FX02.

script.text: Twenty-eight passengers, three crew. Forty minutes from home.
Flying tonight: Captain Mara Vellan and First Officer Dev Okafor.

h418__SH040.title: Cockpit crew intro (S04)
h418__SH040.camera: MS from behind the seats, 35 mm, 1.2 m. Slow LATERAL TRACK RIGHT ~40 cm: captain's shoulder foreground -> centred two-shot.
h418__SH040.action: Calm cockpit, sunset glow. F/O glances to the captain and nods, she half-smiles. Panel soft, hands resting.
h418__SH040.tool_note: Gen AI, KLING 3.0 (3D-guided: Unreal blockout -> key frame -> I2V)
h418__SH040.sync: L3 lands (to 12.4), then ~0.6 s calm before the chime. FX03 cockpit hum.

script.text: Flying tonight: Captain Mara Vellan and First Officer Dev Okafor.

h418__SH050.title: Master warning (S05)
h418__SH050.camera: MS two-shot from between the seats, 28 mm, 1.25 m. Slow PUSH-IN ~30 cm.
h418__SH050.action: Red master-warning glow pulses; both heads snap to the panel; F/O turns to his right window and calls the fire.
h418__SH050.tool_note: Gen AI, KLING 3.0 (3D-guided: Unreal blockout -> key frame -> I2V)
h418__SH050.sync: Chime 13.2 (music hard stop) -> CALLOUT 14.0-15.4 'Fire warning, right engine!' -> fire bell 15.6.

script.text: Fire warning, right engine!

h418__SH060.title: Engine fire + spin-down (REPAIR SHOT) (S06)
h418__SH060.camera: CU right nacelle, 85 mm, wing +1.5 m. Slow ORBIT ~25 deg moving aft: forward 3/4 -> side-on, nacelle locked centre.
h418__SH060.action: Smoke, then orange flame from the nacelle; prop slows from blur to stopped, 4 blades feathered edge-on.
h418__SH060.tool_note: first + last frame; planned repair shot (prop artefacts, fire boil)
h418__SH060.sync: L4 16.2-19.4. FX06 fire roar, FX07 prop wind-down 17.5. Music re-enters as heartbeat drone 16.0.

script.text: Over Lake Tarrow, the right engine catches fire.
The crew starts the engine fire checklist.

h418__SH070.title: Cabin window POV (S07)
h418__SH070.camera: OTS MCU, 50 mm, 1.05 m, slightly down. Slow PUSH-IN ~35 cm to the window (window 1/3 -> 70 % frame).
h418__SH070.action: Over the window passenger's shoulder (60s woman, grey bob): burning right engine, prop feathered, smoke screen-left; her face faint in the glass.
h418__SH070.tool_note: Gen AI, KLING 3.0 (3D-guided: Unreal blockout -> key frame -> I2V)
h418__SH070.sync: L5 19.8-22.6. FX08 muffled fire through window.

script.text: The crew starts the engine fire checklist.

h418__SH080.title: Fire-handle insert (S08)
h418__SH080.camera: ECU insert, 85 mm, 1.1 m, ~15 deg down. Slow PUSH-IN ~10 cm.
h418__SH080.action: Two red T-handles, no labels. F/O's hand (watch, from screen-right) grips and pulls the RIGHT handle.
h418__SH080.tool_note: Traditional Unreal render recommended (hands); Gen AI / KLING alternative; or cut and hold S07
h418__SH080.sync: L6 23.1-26.1. FX09 clunk 24.8 + discharge thump 25.4. Fire bell low.

script.text: Fuel off. Propeller feathered. Fire bottle, discharged.

h418__SH090.title: Second bottle, exterior (S09)
h418__SH090.camera: MWS from aft-right of the wing, 135 mm, wing +4 m. Slow DOLLY-IN ~5 m.
h418__SH090.action: Prop feathered, flame. A brief white puff from the nacelle vents (2nd bottle), the flame dips... and flickers back.
h418__SH090.tool_note: Gen AI, SEEDANCE 2.5 (3D-guided: Unreal blockout -> key frame -> I2V)
h418__SH090.sync: L7 26.4-28.8. FX10 hiss burst 26.8, fire dips then roars back.

script.text: Fuel off. Propeller feathered. Fire bottle, discharged.
Second bottle. The warning stays on.

h418__SH100.title: F/O Mayday call (S10)
h418__SH100.camera: MCU -> CU from the captain side, 85 mm, 1.15 m. Slow PUSH-IN ~25 cm. F/O faces screen-LEFT.
h418__SH100.action: F/O Okafor makes the Mayday call into his boom mic, controlled and fast; orange flicker rim from his right window (screen-right).
h418__SH100.tool_note: lip-sync from the Mayday take; boom mic covers the mouth as a hedge
h418__SH100.sync: MAYDAY (radio) 29.2-32.6, squelch in/out. FX11 radio bed. No narration.

script.text: Mayday, mayday, mayday. Halden 418, engine fire, unable to extinguish.

h418__SH110.title: Captain decision (S11)
h418__SH110.camera: MCU from the F/O side, 50 mm, 1.15 m. Slow LATERAL TRACK RIGHT past the F/O headrest. Captain faces screen-RIGHT.
h418__SH110.action: Capt. Vellan looks out toward the right engine, then turns forward, set jaw. The decision. Silent.
h418__SH110.tool_note: Gen AI, KLING 3.0 (3D-guided: Unreal blockout -> key frame -> I2V)
h418__SH110.sync: L8 32.9-36.5 'twelve minutes away. Too far.' FX12 cockpit, one engine.

script.text: Mayday, mayday, mayday. Halden 418, engine fire, unable to extinguish.
The nearest runway is twelve minutes away. Too far.

h418__SH120.title: Field through the windshield (S12)
h418__SH120.camera: POV between the seats, 24 mm, 1.25 m. Slow PUSH-IN ~30 cm to the glass (windshield 50 -> 75 %).
h418__SH120.action: Horizon tilted in a gentle LEFT turn (high on the left); the long pale stubble field low ahead; low sun off screen-right.
h418__SH120.tool_note: Gen AI, SEEDANCE 2.5 (3D-guided: Unreal blockout -> key frame -> I2V)

script.text: The nearest runway is twelve minutes away. Too far.
Captain Vellan chooses a field instead. Long, flat, and close.

h418__SH130.title: Banking descent (S13)
h418__SH130.camera: WS chase from behind-right, 135 mm. CRANE UP +10 -> +30 m while tilting down: sky behind -> fields behind, horizon to the top edge.
h418__SH130.action: Aircraft banks gently LEFT (away from camera) and descends toward the stubble field, smoke trailing, right prop feathered.
h418__SH130.tool_note: Gen AI, SEEDANCE 2.5 (3D-guided: Unreal blockout -> key frame -> I2V)
h418__SH130.sync: L9 tail, then 1.4 s descent wind (FX13). Music build.

script.text: Captain Vellan chooses a field instead. Long, flat, and close.

h418__SH140.title: Cabin brief (S14)
h418__SH140.camera: MWS -> MS up the aisle, 35 mm, 1.3 m. Slow DOLLY BACK ~40 cm ahead of the FA (size held as she approaches).
h418__SH140.action: Flight attendant shows rows the brace position, moves to the next row. Passengers upright, attentive, one nods. Orange flicker screen-right windows.
h418__SH140.tool_note: Gen AI, KLING 3.0 (3D-guided: Unreal blockout -> key frame -> I2V)
h418__SH140.sync: L10 42.2-44.6. FX14 cabin drone, rattles, murmur.

script.text: The flight attendant briefs the cabin.

h418__SH150.title: Gear + flaps (S15)
h418__SH150.camera: MS from below the right wing, 70 mm, looking up ~20 deg. Slow TRACK RIGHT (overtake) under the wing.
h418__SH150.action: Right main gear drops from the burning nacelle and locks; flaps extend. Prop feathered, flame/smoke screen-left.
h418__SH150.tool_note: first + last frame; swap to nose gear if the nacelle gear reads wrong
h418__SH150.sync: L11 45.2-47.8. FX15 hydraulic whine, down-lock clunk 46.5, wind rising.

script.text: Gear down. Flaps out. Wings level.

h418__SH160.title: Brace (S16)
h418__SH160.camera: WS -> MWS up the aisle, 35 mm, 1.35 m. Slow PUSH-IN ~50 cm to the FA. Cabin shake = comp.
h418__SH160.action: FA on the forward jump seat (harness) calls 'Brace! Heads down, stay down!'. Passengers braced, faces hidden.
h418__SH160.tool_note: Gen AI, KLING 3.0 (3D-guided: Unreal blockout -> key frame -> I2V)
h418__SH160.sync: BRACE 48.4-50.0 (music peaks under it). FX16 cabin shake. Music cuts to silence at 51.0.

script.text: Brace! Heads down, stay down!

h418__SH170.title: Field landing (HERO 3D-guides-AI) (S17)
h418__SH170.camera: WS ground level 1.0 m, 100 mm. TRACK RIGHT at ~half aircraft speed + PAN to hold. Touchdown f60 = 53.5 s.
h418__SH170.action: Aircraft flares, touches down gear-down in the stubble, left -> right, dust and chaff, rolls on straight.
h418__SH170.tool_note: first + last frame; hero breakdown: grey blockout | key frame | final
h418__SH170.sync: FX17a ground rush 51.0, TOUCHDOWN hit 53.5, roll 53.6. L12 54.6-56.2 (1.1 s after impact).

script.text: The aircraft holds together.

h418__SH180.title: Dusk survivors (S18)
h418__SH180.camera: WS, 50 mm. Slow CRANE UP 1.2 -> 4.5 m, slight tilt down. Red/blue spill from vehicles off screen-left.
h418__SH180.action: Blue dusk. Intact aircraft, nose screen-right, blackened right nacelle with a wisp. 3-4 passengers in blankets walk toward camera.
h418__SH180.tool_note: Gen AI, SEEDANCE 2.5 (3D-guided: Unreal blockout -> key frame -> I2V)
h418__SH180.sync: L13 56.6-59.8. FX18 distant sirens, ticking metal. Music: resolving chord.

script.text: The aircraft holds together.
All thirty-one people on board walk away.

h418__SH190.title: Night aerial pull-up (S19)
h418__SH190.camera: Top-down, 35 mm. Slow VERTICAL RISE 40 -> 110 m, no rotation, no drift. Nose screen-right.
h418__SH190.action: Bookend to S02: aircraft at rest in the long field, skid track behind (screen-left), ring of emergency lights, dark patchwork, distant lake glint.
h418__SH190.tool_note: Gen AI, SEEDANCE 2.5 (3D-guided: Unreal blockout -> key frame -> I2V)
h418__SH190.sync: L14 60.2-63.8. FX19 night wind, sirens fading.

script.text: A checklist done right, and a field chosen early.

h418__SH200.title: Disclosure card (S20)
h418__SH200.action: 'Dramatization. Fictional event.' + 'AI-generated imagery, narration, music and sound effects.'
h418__SH200.sync: FX20 soft low tone, music fades across the card.

h418__note_00.author: Director
h418__note_00.text: The plane is moving too fast and the camera is already moving too much. The plane should move at a steady, linear, realistic speed.

h418__note_01.author: Director
h418__note_01.text: What's going on here? The plane isn't tracked properly in either camera.

h418__note_02.author: Director
h418__note_02.text: The passenger and the plane wing can never face each other like this.

h418__note_03.author: Director
h418__note_03.text: Not sure what's happening in this camera.

h418__note_04.author: Director
h418__note_04.text:
The camera needs to be tracked properly,
and the animation curves should be linear.

h418__note_05.author: Director
h418__note_05.text: The flight attendant shouldn't be in a seat; she should be in the middle of the aisle.

h418__SH030__layoutflag_01.author: Supervisor
h418__SH030__layoutflag_01.text: BLOCKER: 3/4 rear -> side-on can't happen: at 250 m a 16 m overtake turns the view ~4 deg. -> CAM_SH030_fix in the file: 85 mm, 60 m out, track from 45 deg behind to side-on (24 m/s overtake) with a pan to hold. | BLOCKER: Panel A shows the gear DOWN (cruise = gear up). -> Repaint A gear up. | CHECK: Panels are ~2x tighter than the note (plane ~95 % of frame vs ~45 % at 200 mm / 250 m). -> Pick one. | MINOR: At 600 m with pitch -3.5 and 200 mm the ground is out of frame (panels show fields below). -> Pitch ~-8 or fly lower.

h418__SH060__layoutflag_01.author: Supervisor
h418__SH060__layoutflag_01.text: BLOCKER: 'Wing +1.5 m' puts the camera above the high wing: at the side-on end the wing hides the nacelle (render: wing top). The panels are at nacelle level, under the wing. -> CAM_SH060_fix in the file: same orbit 0.3 m below nacelle centre, radius 20 m. | BLOCKER: Panel B prop has 8 blades and is not feathered edge-on; flame comes out of the FRONT of the nacelle (brief: rear/exhaust). -> Repaint B: 4 blades edge-on, flame aft. | CHECK: 85 mm at 12 m = 5 m frame: nacelle + prop (~7 m) don't fit; the panels frame ~10 m. -> Radius ~20 m or ~50 mm. | CHECK: Spin-down keys (disc -> blades f70, stop f100, feather f100-120) end after the 4 s cut (96 f). -> Built scaled: blades f+56, stop f+80, feathered by the last frame. Update the shot list.

h418__SH130__layoutflag_01.author: Supervisor
h418__SH130__layoutflag_01.text: BLOCKER: Camera above the aircraft (+10 -> +30 m) always sees ground behind it: 'start against the sky' is impossible, and at 135 mm (8.6 deg tall) the horizon is never in frame. -> CAM_SH130_fix in the file: crane -8 -> +12 m (sky -> fields). Or ~50 mm. | BLOCKER: Panel A has the gear DOWN (comes down in S15), B gear up; A puts a field above the horizon and the sun in frame low centre. -> Repaint A: gear up, sky with the field below. | MINOR: Descent 40 m per 5 s = 8 m/s (~1,600 fpm), steep but OK for an emergency; kept physical.

h418__SH170__layoutflag_01.author: Supervisor
h418__SH170__layoutflag_01.text: BLOCKER: Panel B has no fire or smoke (rule: still burning S11-S17) and 8 spinning-looking blades on the feathered right prop; A is backlit. -> Repaint B: smoke from the right nacelle, right prop feathered. | CHECK: 100 mm at 150 m: plane ~40 % of frame; panels ~85 % (2x tighter). -> ~75 m out or ~200 mm. | CHECK: 'Start left third, end right of centre' vs 'pan to hold' (a look-at keeps it centred). Built centred. -> Pick one: lagging pan or locked. | MINOR: Blockout 'flare from 6 m' vs board 'gear 2 m above the stubble': built gear 2 m (root 4.35 m). Speeds check: 52 m/s (~100 kt) touchdown at f1283 = 53.5 s, camera 25 m/s = half.

h418__note_10.author: Director
h418__note_10.text: We're showing the other pilot, but only the seat of the pilot closest to camera is visible, which makes the cockpit look empty. Remove it.

h418__note_11.author: Director
h418__note_11.text: Too close to the controls. Should we be showing a screen or something?

h418__note_12.author: Director
h418__note_12.text: Make sure the sun position matches the previous shot.

h418__note_13.author: Director
h418__note_13.text:
The first and last images don't match: in the first frame the plane's nose points top right, in the last frame bottom right.
First frame: the sun is on the left side of the plane.
Last frame: the sun is behind the plane.

h418__note_14.author: Director
h418__note_14.text: This reads like a take-off: the plane is ascending.

h418__note_15.author: Director
h418__note_15.text: The fire is on the engine and should stay there, not spread over the plane.

h418__note_16.author: Director
h418__note_16.text: Not sure the plane is moving in this one.

h418__note_17.author: Director
h418__note_17.text: The camera and the pilot are moving together. The pilot should either walk slowly or just stand and do a routine check.
